summary: The stripes are NOT along-depth banding: they are planes of constant array index 2 (x) that extend over the whole y and z (sheets normal to x). They show up as vertical streaks in z-x planes AND in x-y planes; z-y planes are clean. Their period is 7.518 vox at 0.04 mm = 0.3007 mm = 15.0 slices at 20 um, and the phase-folded waveform is a sawtooth (ramp over ~6 vox, sharp drop) with adjacent-plane correlation lowest right after each drop: the classic serial-section signature. Together with (i) adjacent-plane NCC of 0.43 along x vs 0.65/0.67 along z/y, (ii) a 70.5-vox (2.82 mm) tile periodicity present in BOTH z and y (mean profile and adjacent-plane NCC bumps), and (iii) FOV extents that step as a function of x, this says array axis 2 (x, 1595@20um) is the physical sectioning/depth axis and axes 0 (z) and 1 (y) are the en-face mosaic axes with 2.82 mm tiles. The prep's slab normalisation ran along axis 0 (an en-face axis): it left only smooth per-z-slice offsets (std 1.8% of level, no periodic component) and did not touch the section sawtooth. Local stripe amplitude: std ~1500 (9% of the 16.8k level, 28% of tissue std) per 1-mm chunk, up to 2400 (16%) in the worst region; 30 isolated dropout planes. The pattern decorrelates along z within ~2 mm (adjacent 1-mm chunk NCC 0.48, 4 mm apart ~0), so the correction has to be local. Best recipe: an x-flat-field by normalised convolution (smooth over z,y with sigma 12 vox, high-pass along x with sigma 6, subtract) applied to the full octv in 73 s; x-profile residual std 138 -> 51 (oct150: 85 -> 49), stripe spectral energy down 9-14x, y/z profiles unchanged. Recipes (a) per-z-slice offset and (b) running-median along z do nothing measurable. Vessel channel: the existing octv_vessels density per x-plane is modulated 2.5x by the section phase (35% of its variance); on 200^3 crops the Frangi top-1% is 41-61% single-voxel speckle-scale responses, its tube axes avoid x entirely (elongated components within 15 deg of x: 0-1% vs 3.4% isotropic; mean|cos x| 0.31-0.35 vs 0.5), and intensity destriping alone does not fix the section-phase modulation (4.4x -> 5.3x in crop A, 4.1x -> 2.5x in crop B) because the per-plane in-plane noise level itself is section-phase modulated (1.8x, 75% of variance). Adding per-x-plane texture equalisation flattens the modulation (5.3x -> 1.4x, 2.5x -> 1.6x) but the mask remains confined to section planes: with the current 3-D Frangi recipe the OCT vessel channel is not salvageable; it would need per-section-plane 2-D detection with per-plane thresholds and cross-plane linking. Black blocks: exactly 0.0, 20.7% of octv, one connected region = complement of a non-box FOV (corner rectangles + z-caps stepping at x = 5.6, 8.9, 20.0 mm); >= 1.27 mm from the 2-mm-eroded tissue, but 23.5% of the current (agarose-including) mask boundary touches them and 2.4% of mask voxels lie within 0.3 mm of a zero, so masked trilinear resampling smears zeros into the mask edge; they must be treated as missing (weight 0), never as dark tissue.
recipe:
DESTRIPE (validated, applied to full octv and derived oct150; script work/probe_xr/stripes/p3_full.py, defaults 12 12 6 add):
  v = octv float32 (0.04 mm iso, axes (z,y,x)); valid = v > 0  (zeros = missing, keep them zero)
  A = G(sz=12, sy=12, sx=0)(v*valid) / G(12,12,0)(valid)      # Gaussian normalised convolution over z and y only, truncate 3 sigma; ok = denominator > 0.05
  B = G(0, 0, sx=6)(A*ok) / G(0,0,6)(ok)                       # low-pass of A along x
  S = where(ok, A - B, 0)                                     # stripe map: structure narrower than ~0.5 mm in x, smooth over >=1 mm in y and z
  v_destriped = where(valid, clip(v - S, 1, 65000), 0)        # additive (multiplicative v*B/A gave identical/slightly worse numbers)
  Implementation: z-chunks of 64 slices with 40-slice padding, 4 worker processes (scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter, OMP=1 each), 73 s for 728x1006x797; outputs octv_destriped.npy (float16) and octv_stripeS.npy.
  0.15 mm level: oct150_destriped = where(oct150>0, clip(oct150 - S150, 1), 0) with S150 = trilinear resample of pool_mean_np(S, 4) onto the oct150 grid (octreg.common.resample_to_grid).
  At 20-um native resolution (recommended for prep_subject.py, before pooling): same filter with sigma = (24, 24, 12) voxels; additionally move oct_slab_normalize from axis 0 to axis 2 with window 15 slices (one section) or drop it (it is an en-face axis).
  Parameter evidence: sz=40 or sy=30/sz=40 (longer windows) remove 2-4x less stripe energy because the pattern decorrelates along z within ~2 mm; sx=3 removes less (kx-line 0.0165 vs 0.0042); sx=12/20 further reduce broad section-group bands (crop-B x-profile residual 239 -> 97 -> 60) but with higher risk of removing sheet-like anatomy aligned with the section planes; vessel metrics unchanged between sx=6/12/20.
  Not useful: (a) per-z-slice additive offset (subtract per-slice median inside eroded mask, add global median) and (b) running-median (25-slice) high-pass of the per-z-slice profile: no measurable change in any metric (z is not the sectioning axis; residual per-z-slice offsets are smooth, std 1.8% of level).
VESSEL BRANCH ONLY (tested on crops, p3_texeq.py): after the flat-field, per-x-plane texture equalisation: lp = G(2,2,0)(v'); hp = v' - lp; s(x) = std(hp[:,:,x][mask]); ref = median_filter(s, 15 planes); v'' = lp + hp * clip(ref/s, 0.3, 3). Then Frangi with sigmas >= 1.325 vox only (drop 0.6, 0.9). This flattens the section-phase modulation of the top-1% mask to 1.4-2.3x but does not restore tubes crossing section planes (0% along x); a usable channel needs 2-D detection per section plane (z-y planes) with per-plane percentile thresholds and cross-plane linking (untested).
MASK / RESAMPLING: valid = octv > 0 (or oct150 > 0) eroded by 2 voxels at 0.15 mm (4 at 0.04 mm); pass it as a weight (0 = missing) into NCC and use normalised-convolution / masked resampling (sum(v*w)/sum(w)); never let zeros enter as intensity 0. Tissue mask should be re-derived from the destriped volume and exclude agarose (out of scope here).
CHARACTERISATION METHOD (reproducible, p3_char.py/p3_destripe.py/p3_fold.py): per-plane mean/median inside the old mask eroded by 2 mm (13 vox at 0.15 mm, mapped nearest onto the octv grid) along each axis, detrended by a 60-slice running mean, Hann FFT, autocorrelation; phase-folding at the FFT period; NCC between adjacent in-plane high-passed (sigma 3) planes along each axis; per-1-mm z-chunk stripe maps S_c = HP_x(LP_y(mean_z)) and their NCC matrix; 3-D power spectrum of a 200^3 crop (energy on the kx line and kz=0 plane); Frangi (octreg.features.frangi_dark_vesselness, prep sigmas 0.6/0.9/1.325/1.8/2.65 and prep gammas) top-1% inside the eroded mask, tube axis = eigenvector of the smallest-|lambda| Hessian eigenvalue at the best scale (scipy gaussian derivatives), fraction within 15 deg of each axis (isotropic expectation 1-cos15 = 3.4%), per-x-plane density folded at 7.518 vox, connected components >= 30 voxels with PCA elongation >= 3 and their principal axis.

caveats: 1. Axis interpretation is an inference from the data, not from metadata: the sawtooth waveform with a sharp drop at a 15.0-slice period along array axis 2 (x), the decorrelation of adjacent planes along x only, the 2.82-mm tile periodicity in both z and y, and FOV extents that step along x all point to x being the sectioning/depth axis and (z, y) the en-face axes, i.e. the opposite of the working assumption (z = depth) and of what prep_subject.py assumes for oct_slab_normalize (window 60 along axis 0). Please confirm with the acquisition metadata before changing prep; the destripe recipe itself is agnostic (it is defined on array axes). 2. The x-flat-field removes any structure narrower than ~0.5 mm along x that is smooth over >= 1 mm in both y and z; anatomy forming sheets exactly parallel to the section planes would be attenuated (tilted structures survive). Broad section-group intensity bands (0.8-1.6 mm wide, e.g. octv x 200-300, y 500-800, z 100-450) survive sigma_x = 6 and are only removed with sigma_x 12-20 at higher leakage risk; they also survive in oct150. 3. oct150_destriped was built as oct150 - S150 (S mean-pooled by 4 and trilinear-resampled), not by re-running the prep chain from destriped 20-um data; validated only by the x-profile residual (85 -> 49) and visual inspection; its zero/partial-volume edge voxels are those of the original oct150. 4. Residual per-z-slice offsets (1.8% of level) and the 2.82-mm tile modulation in y and z (~2.7% p2p) were characterised but not corrected; at 0.15 mm they are small against WM/GM contrast and should not matter for NCC-based affine registration. 5. The remaining per-plane texture difference along x (in-plane noise std modulated 1.3-1.8x with the section phase, adjacent-plane NCC 0.43 unchanged by the flat-field) is intrinsic to the sections and cannot be removed by a smooth intensity correction; it is what breaks any 3-D tube detector across section planes. 6. Vessel tests are on two 200^3 crops (CPU, prep's sigmas and gammas) plus the per-plane statistics of the existing full-volume mask; no full-volume Frangi re-run after destriping was done (no GPU jobs allowed for probes). The suggested per-section-plane 2-D detection was not tested. 7. Isotropic reference for the orientation test (3.4% within 15 deg of an axis) assumes uniformly random tube directions; genuine anatomy in a brainstem block is anisotropic, so the y/z excess (up to 3x) cannot be attributed to artefact alone, whereas the complete absence of x-aligned elongated components (0-1%) can. 8. All zeros are exactly 0.0 in octv; in oct150 trilinear resampling created values down to 0.0023 next to the blocks, so a threshold of v > 0 is insufficient at 0.15 mm: use v > ~1000 (or the octv validity mask pooled with a min filter) eroded by 2 voxels. 9. Runs used the mask supplied (old mask includes agarose) for the flat-field support and a 2-mm-eroded version for all statistics; stripes are also present in the agarose, which is helpful for the estimate but means the amplitude numbers inside tissue include tissue-dependent sawtooth amplitude. 10. Outputs occupy 2.4 GB under work/probe_xr/stripes/ (two full float16 volumes); nothing under work/xiangrui_I58bs, work/runs, data or octreg was modified.
